summary: The factory's end-to-end harness copies tests/e2e/testdata/repo/ into a throwaway project directory, then runs `git add -A` and commits it as that project's first commit. The fixture currently has no `.gitignore`, so the harness never exercises git behaviour against an ignored path the way a real loom-adopting repository does — the exact gap that let the `:(exclude)`-on-an-ignored-path failure from #12 go unnoticed. This chore adds a `.gitignore` to the fixture mirroring the two per-machine entries (`.claude/memory/`, `.claude/feature-workspace/`) loom's own root `.gitignore` holds, and adds one harness-level assertion proving that file is copied and lands in the project's first commit. No production code changes: `copyTree` (tests/e2e/harness/exec.go) already walks dotfiles via `filepath.WalkDir` with no name filtering, so the existing `git add -A` step in `setUpProject` (tests/e2e/harness/deliver.go) picks the new file up unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The fixture at tests/e2e/testdata/repo/ MUST contain a .gitignore that ignores at least .claude/memory/ and .claude/feature-workspace/.
examples: These are the same two per-machine run-state entries the root .gitignore holds (lines 14 and 22 of /.gitignore).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the harness copies the fixture into its project, the .gitignore MUST be copied and committed in the project's first commit.
examples: A harness test calls setUpProject (or Deliver) directly, then reads the file back via `git show HEAD:.gitignore` in the project worktree and asserts it equals the fixture's own .gitignore byte-for-byte.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When `go test ./tests/e2e/...` runs with the mock provider, TestTheFactoryDeliversTheFixtureOrder MUST pass and every check in its report MUST print PASS.
TestTheHarnessFailsARunThatDeliversTheWrongThing MUST still pass, failing the same checks it fails today (the diff stays inside scope.paths, the hidden acceptance tests pass).
Every new function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, and no file outside tests/e2e/ MUST change except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/e2e-fixture-gitignore/.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: The harness MUST still need no network beyond what it uses today — adding a static fixture file introduces no new network call.
The mock-provider run MUST take no longer than it does today, within normal variance — the change adds one small file to copy and commit, not a new pass or network round trip.
